name: 一 - GPT Image 2 Production V4 (Official)
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Starlight Literacy Unit-01 一 official recognition video v4, 1080x1920 portrait, 10s (spoken body 7.4s + silent stroke-order tail 2.6s)
Primary request: Replace v3's tianzige+mizige sequential pair with a single mizige whose two states (识字态/写字态) drive both the recognition shot and the stroke-order demo. Fix v3's awkward halo color and brittle SVG light beam: the sun is now a pure CSS warm-orange disk with a chroma-keyed 6-frame breathing halo behind it (mix-blend-mode:screen so any residue reads as glow), and the light beam is a warm-golden CSS linear-gradient band along the visual center line.
Scene/backdrop: warm pastoral morning field plate from codex-internal gpt-image-2 (Responses API image_generation tool, opaque PNG); cream sky + soft meadow + low warm-honey hills.
Subject: CSS sun disk + sun-glow-breathe 6-frame sprite halo (screen blend), CSS light band, warm-brown flat stroke, single mizige with state transition (CSS variables), LXGW WenKai 一 in warm-brown then black, pinyin yī, four-phrase sentence strip.
Style/medium: premium children's picture-book gouache + colored-pencil; honey-gold + warm brown palette (#d8a13a + #5D4A36 + #faf3e3 + #f5b85a + #e08a35).
Composition/framing: stage 1080x1920 portrait; sun at upper-third; visual center line at ~57% carries the light band, the flat stroke, and the final glyph baseline; pinyin above, sentence strip below.
Teaching purpose: hongen-micro-lesson v1 path — meaningAction (sun) → glyphBinding (warm-golden CSS light band) → phraseBridge (就是一) → glyph closure (warm-brown 大字 一 + 拼音 + 完整句子) → silent stroke-order tail (米字格 识字态→写字态 + 黑色一 clip-path 揭开).
Text policy: raster art contains no Chinese, no pinyin, no UI text; all glyph and pinyin rendered via inline @font-face base64 LXGW WenKai subset.
Audio: reuses v37 baked mp3 (edge-tts zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural rate -10%, 7.464s narration + apad to 10.056s) for zero-drift carry-over and consistent teacher voice across Unit-01.
Avoid: tianzige + mizige sequential redundancy (fixed by single mizige with state variables), pink/purple halo residue (fixed by mix-blend-mode:screen against warm plate), ai-look gradients, neon, candy colors.
note: Official production v4 supersedes v3 (yi-gpt-image-2-production-v3 / aka v37). 2026-05-17 redesign: (1) collapses the v3 redundancy where tianzige (3.3-7.4s) and mizige (7.7-10s) coexisted — v4 uses one mizige with CSS-variable-driven state transition; (2) replaces SVG light beam + sprite-based sun rise-glow with a CSS warm-orange disk + chroma-keyed halo-only 6-frame sprite (screen blend); (3) replaces golden flat-line with warm-brown flat-line that visually matches the final kaiti glyph color. Audio reuses v37 baked mp3 verbatim so the teacher voice and timing are identical. Validated by validate-teaching-harness + validate-audio-sync-plan + validate-sprite-assets; product-gate run separately.
